@graph.name: Entry 14: a third rider (JAAM) qualifies the transfer — and a framing correction
@graph.text: The energy law and the −0.13 offset are consistent a third time (canonical 5.4% med|Δ%| with data-implied mass; smooth ε=0.20 best at 3.5%; offset 0.133, bootstrap CI 0.102–0.186) — but the geometric-ε skill does NOT transfer: it fails outright on JAAM's gentle-heavy bulk and is inconclusive on the thin real-descent subset. The skill works for riders who coast (P. Paz), not for riders who pedal descents (JAAM). Framing corrected: P. Paz and JAAM are independent third-party riders, not Pedal Hidrográfico members; only the censo is a collective corpus.
